users_org_or_platform_admin.name: users_org_or_platform_admin
users_org_or_platform_admin.value: ("users"."is_platform_admin" and "users"."org_id" is null) or (not "users"."is_platform_admin" and "users"."org_id" is not null)

contractor_benefits_dates_check.name: contractor_benefits_dates_check
contractor_benefits_dates_check.value: "contractor_benefits"."valid_from" is null or "contractor_benefits"."valid_to" is null or "contractor_benefits"."valid_to" >= "contractor_benefits"."valid_from"

contractors_regime2_check.name: contractors_regime2_check
contractors_regime2_check.value: "contractors"."regime2_code" is null or ("contractors"."regime_code" is not null and "contractors"."regime2_code" <> "contractors"."regime_code")

assignments_own_check.name: assignments_own_check
assignments_own_check.value: ("assignments"."own_period" is null and "assignments"."own_day" is null and "assignments"."own_month" is null) or ("assignments"."own_period" in ('M', 'Q', 'H', 'Y') and "assignments"."own_day" between 1 and 31 and "assignments"."own_month" between case when "assignments"."own_period" = 'Y' then 1 else 0 end and 12)

audit_log_insert_guard.name: audit_log_insert_guard
audit_log_insert_guard.withCheck: "audit_log"."actor_user_id" is not distinct from app.current_user_id() and "audit_log"."at" = now() and app.history_actor_allowed("audit_log"."actor_user_id", "audit_log"."org_id")

view_settings_platform_admin.name: view_settings_platform_admin
view_settings_platform_admin.using: "view_settings"."org_id" is null and app.current_org_id() is null and "view_settings"."user_id" = app.current_user_id()
view_settings_platform_admin.withCheck: "view_settings"."org_id" is null and app.current_org_id() is null and "view_settings"."user_id" = app.current_user_id()

status_history_insert_guard.name: status_history_insert_guard
status_history_insert_guard.withCheck: "status_history"."actor_user_id" is not distinct from app.current_user_id() and "status_history"."at" = now() and app.history_actor_allowed("status_history"."actor_user_id", "status_history"."org_id")

status_history_status_check.name: status_history_status_check
status_history_status_check.value: ("status_history"."scale" = 'report' and "status_history"."to_status" in ('todo', 'in_progress', 'submitted', 'waiting', 'confirmed', 'needs_fix', 'not_required') and ("status_history"."from_status" is null or "status_history"."from_status" in ('todo', 'in_progress', 'submitted', 'waiting', 'confirmed', 'needs_fix', 'not_required'))) or ("status_history"."scale" = 'payment' and "status_history"."to_status" in ('unpaid', 'partial', 'paid', 'not_required') and ("status_history"."from_status" is null or "status_history"."from_status" in ('unpaid', 'partial', 'paid', 'not_required'))) or ("status_history"."scale" = 'task' and "status_history"."to_status" in ('todo', 'in_progress', 'rework', 'on_confirm', 'confirmed', 'done', 'failed', 'cancelled') and ("status_history"."from_status" is null or "status_history"."from_status" in ('todo', 'in_progress', 'rework', 'on_confirm', 'confirmed', 'done', 'failed', 'cancelled'))) or ("status_history"."scale" = 'service' and "status_history"."to_status" in ('active', 'paused', 'archived') and ("status_history"."from_status" is null or "status_history"."from_status" in ('active', 'paused', 'archived'))) or ("status_history"."scale" = 'project' and "status_history"."to_status" in ('planned', 'in_progress', 'done', 'cancelled') and ("status_history"."from_status" is null or "status_history"."from_status" in ('planned', 'in_progress', 'done', 'cancelled'))) or ("status_history"."scale" = 'indicator' and "status_history"."to_status" in ('empty', 'filled', 'checked') and ("status_history"."from_status" is null or "status_history"."from_status" in ('empty', 'filled', 'checked')))

status_history_rollback_reason_check.name: status_history_rollback_reason_check
status_history_rollback_reason_check.value: not "status_history"."is_rollback" or ("status_history"."from_status" is not null and "status_history"."reason" is not null and btrim("status_history"."reason") <> '')

report_types_rule_check.name: report_types_rule_check
report_types_rule_check.value:
"report_types"."due_day" >= 1 and ("report_types"."due_after" is null or "report_types"."due_after" between 0 and 12)
        and ("report_types"."due_month" is null or "report_types"."due_month" between 1 and 12)
        and ("report_types"."pay_day" is null or "report_types"."pay_day" between 1 and 31)
        and ("report_types"."pay_after" is null or "report_types"."pay_after" between 0 and 12)
        and ("report_types"."pay_month" is null or "report_types"."pay_month" between 1 and 12)
        and "report_types"."skip_quarters" <@ array[1, 2, 3, 4]::smallint[]

tax_benefit_due_rules_rule_check.name: tax_benefit_due_rules_rule_check
tax_benefit_due_rules_rule_check.value:
("tax_benefit_due_rules"."due_day" is null or "tax_benefit_due_rules"."due_day" between 1 and 31)
        and ("tax_benefit_due_rules"."due_after" is null or "tax_benefit_due_rules"."due_after" between 0 and 12)
        and ("tax_benefit_due_rules"."due_month" is null or "tax_benefit_due_rules"."due_month" between 1 and 12)
        and ("tax_benefit_due_rules"."pay_day" is null or "tax_benefit_due_rules"."pay_day" between 1 and 31)
        and ("tax_benefit_due_rules"."pay_after" is null or "tax_benefit_due_rules"."pay_after" between 0 and 12)

dict_change_requests_insert_guard.name: dict_change_requests_insert_guard
dict_change_requests_insert_guard.withCheck: "dict_change_requests"."created_by" = app.current_user_id() and "dict_change_requests"."status" = 'new' and "dict_change_requests"."answer" = '' and "dict_change_requests"."decided_by" is null and "dict_change_requests"."decided_at" is null

employee_wallets_update_own.withCheck: "employee_wallets"."employee_id" in (select e.id from employees e where e.user_id = app.current_user_id())

employee_wallets_delete_own.using: "employee_wallets"."employee_id" in (select e.id from employees e where e.user_id = app.current_user_id())

employee_wallets_fields_check.name: employee_wallets_fields_check
employee_wallets_fields_check.value: ("employee_wallets"."kind" = 'acc' and "employee_wallets"."bank_code" is not null and "employee_wallets"."account_no" is not null and "employee_wallets"."phone" is null and cardinality("employee_wallets"."phone_banks") = 0) or ("employee_wallets"."kind" = 'phone' and "employee_wallets"."phone" ~ '^[+][0-9]{6,15}$' and cardinality("employee_wallets"."phone_banks") between 1 and 50 and "employee_wallets"."bank_code" is null and "employee_wallets"."account_no" is null)

org_accounts_fields_check.name: org_accounts_fields_check
org_accounts_fields_check.value: ("org_accounts"."kind" = 'acc' and "org_accounts"."bank_code" is not null and "org_accounts"."account_no" is not null and "org_accounts"."bik" ~ '^[0-9]{6}$' and "org_accounts"."phone" is null and cardinality("org_accounts"."phone_banks") = 0) or ("org_accounts"."kind" = 'phone' and "org_accounts"."phone" ~ '^[+][0-9]{6,15}$' and cardinality("org_accounts"."phone_banks") between 1 and 50 and "org_accounts"."bank_code" is null and "org_accounts"."account_no" is null and "org_accounts"."bik" is null)

files_deleted_check.name: files_deleted_check
files_deleted_check.value: ("files"."state" = 'deleted') = ("files"."deleted_at" is not null and "files"."deleted_by" is not null)
